name: brainstorming
description: Structured brainstorming and design exploration for Stella. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation. Asks clarifying questions one at a time, proposes 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, presents a design for approval, and produces a design-doc summary. Nothing is implemented until the user approves the design. Pure-Python, no external dependencies, runs on any surface.

operation.description: One of: explore | questions | approaches | design | checklist | sources. Defaults to sources.

topic.description: The idea, feature or topic to brainstorm about.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 10.

author: Stella
notes: Pure-Python skill. No code is written or modified until the user approves a design. Follows the brainstorming hard-gate: explore -> clarify -> propose -> design -> approve.
